corrections.reason: claim_mumbai_birth_cfc_issues_certificate_and_receipt asserts only that the Citizen Facilitation Center agent collects the necessary fees and required documents. Under the PROTOCOL section 8 after-submission definition, a step at or before submission, including document presentation and payment, is not after-submission evidence, so this claim cannot support the cell. The cell remains stated on claim_mumbai_birth_cfc_issues_certificate_and_receipt_2, which gives the printed certificate and the fee receipt the applicant receives.

No state change: after-submission stays stated.
